services.desc: The Museum’s SR-71 was used to set the World Absolute Speed Record of 2,193 mph in 1976. The record still stands today. This MH-53 special operations helicopter flew combat missions during the Vietnam War, Desert Storm, and Iraqi Freedom. A-7D AC-130U Fuselage AGM-28A Hound Dog BQM-34F Firebee II BQM-34A-53 Firebee
